title: tc-diff-viewer
description: The changes to a set of files: a row per file with its status and line counts, opening to a line diff.

heading.description: The heading; empty leaves the header out

description.description: Small text under the heading – the branch, or what it's compared with

files.description: The changed files, in the order to show them

expanded.description: The paths of the open files; unset opens the first `autoExpand`

autoExpand.description: How many files start open when `expanded` is unset

maxHeight.description: Height in px at which one file's diff scrolls; 0 lets it grow

wrap.description: Wrap long lines instead of scrolling sideways

labels.description: Renames the status words and buttons

path.description: The file's path, which also identifies it

before.description: Its text before; omit or "" for a new file

after.description: Its text after; omit or "" for a deleted file

status.description: By default worked out from the texts and `previousPath`

previousPath.description: The old path of a renamed file

language.description: The language for the colours; by default the path's extension

binary.description: A file with no text to compare: the row says so, and doesn't open
